topStatements.query: SELECT "public"."Media"."id", "public"."Media"."url", "public"."Media"."type", "public"."Media"."tenantId", "public"."Media"."createdAt" FROM "public"."Media" LEFT JOIN "public"."Tenant" AS "j1" ON ("j1"."id") = ("public"."Media"."tenantId") WHERE ("public"."Media"."url" = $1 AND "public"."Media"."tenantId" = $2 AND (("j1"."id") IN (SELECT "t2"."tenantId" FROM "public"."TenantUser" AS "t2" WHERE ("t2"."userId" = $3 AND "t2"."tenantId" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("j1"."id" IS NOT NULL))) LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5

SELECT "public"."Tenant"."id", "public"."Tenant"."name", "public"."Tenant"."domain", "public"."Tenant"."createdAt", "public"."Tenant"."updatedAt" FROM "public"."Tenant" WHERE ("public"."Tenant"."id" = $1 AND 1=1) LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3

SELECT status, count(*)::bigint AS count,
            min("createdAt") AS oldest,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Processing' AND ("leaseUntil" IS NULL OR "leaseUntil" < now()))::bigint AS expired
            FROM "ExportTask" WHERE "expiresAt" > now() GROUP BY status

SELECT "public"."ExportTask"."id", "public"."ExportTask"."tenantId", "public"."ExportTask"."userId", "public"."ExportTask"."status", "public"."ExportTask"."payload", "public"."ExportTask"."createdAt", "public"."ExportTask"."expiresAt", "public"."ExportTask"."dispatchedAt", "public"."ExportTask"."leaseUntil", "public"."ExportTask"."leaseToken" FROM "public"."ExportTask" WHERE ("public"."ExportTask"."expiresAt" > $1 AND (("public"."ExportTask"."status" = $2 AND ("public"."ExportTask"."dispatchedAt" IS NULL OR "public"."ExportTask"."dispatchedAt" < $3)) OR ("public"."ExportTask"."status" = $4 AND "public"."ExportTask"."leaseUntil" < $5))) ORDER BY "public"."ExportTask"."createdAt" ASC LIMIT $6 OFFSET $7
